flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Find a stock or scarcity message on the first product (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") and store its exact text as stock_1.
Get the first product name from the product title and save as {{first_product_name}}.
Reload the page and store {{first_product_name}}'s stock message as stock_2.
Reload once more and store {{first_product_name}}'s stock message as stock_3.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
The browser page or its session was closed unexpectedly during analysis. The catalog itself had loaded and showed the first product and its stock text, but the automation lost access before it could save all three required observations.
Check the browser-session lifecycle and screenshot service for unexpected teardown, then rerun the task. Keep the page open through the two reloads and all variable saves.
one_liner: The run stopped because the browser page closed before the automation could capture the screen or finish the stock checks.
